children: Quanome Technologies entered into a Purchase and Sale Agreement with Compal Electronics to acquire 32 GPU server units for approximately $18.8 million to support its planned AI computing infrastructure business. The Company will pay 20% upon purchase order acceptance and 80% before shipment, subject to delivery and other conditions. Servers are expected to be delivered to a designated U.S. data center, with customary warranty, inspection, and refund rights provided by Compal.
